predicate.label: has athlete on team
predicate.definition: Team or sporting organization X has or had person Y as a player or competing athlete.
includes: explicit player or athlete on X
X fields or plays Y as an athlete
a stated playing membership in X
excludes: wanting or needing Y without roster membership
an opponent rather than a team member
ordinary possession or a book title
predicate.notes: Inverse of athlete_for. A team needing a person does not prove that the person plays for it.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit player or athlete on X; X fields or plays Y as an athlete; a stated playing membership in X. Excludes: coach or manager alone; wanting or needing Y without roster membership; an opponent rather than a team member; ordinary possession or a book title. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic have without athlete-role context; proposed recruitment without established membership; unclear team or player identity. Inverse of athlete_for. A team needing a person does not prove that the person plays for it.

rationale: Knicks→Ewing paired with have/need/play dominates roster semantics; need alone is not actual membership. The literary Heather→Mommies pair is separate.
